name: unit_lab_convert
description: Convert laboratory results between mg/dL, mg/L or g/L and mmol/L or umol/L for glucose, total, HDL and LDL cholesterol, triglycerides (as triolein), creatinine, urea, BUN, uric acid and calcium, with exact factors derived from molar masses computed from the IUPAC/CIAAW atomic weights. Every output carries a disclaimer: not medical advice, verify with a clinician.

to.description: Default: the analyte's usual unit on the other side

list_analytes.description: List analytes, formulas, molar masses and factors

catalog.source: Molar masses from IUPAC/CIAAW standard atomic weights (conventional values, https://www.ciaaw.org/atomic-weights.htm); triglyceride convention as triolein (C57H104O6); BUN as urea nitrogen (2 N per urea)
